source_evidence: Broker-dealers charge a fee to handle trades between the buyers and sellers of securities. A broker-dealer may buy securities from their customer who is selling or sell from their own inventory to its customer who is buying.
answer: Market participants can play different roles in securities trading. A broker-dealer handles trades between buyers and sellers for a fee. Depending on the transaction, it may buy securities from a customer who is selling or sell securities from its own inventory to a customer who is buying.
